Name: Seven Section's Blade
Need: Level 1 Seven Section Associate
Desc:
*Weapon (longsword)*

Due to its construction, the scabbard is just as deadly as the blade itself, and there is a hidden compartment in the pommel where a long pointed rod can be removed from.
You may choose to deal Slashing, piercing, or bludgeoning damage when dealing damage with this weapon. Additionally, if you are affiliated with seven association, you gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon. This benefit increases to +2 at 7th level, and again to +3 at 14th level.

Name: Cinq Association's Rapier
Need: Level 1 Cinq Association associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Rapier)*

An elegantly crafted weapon for an elegant fighter.
For every 10ft moved in a straight line on your turn, add 1d4 piercing damage. This Benefit does not carry over between rounds (Ex: you cannot move 30ft one turn then another 30ft on the next turn for the next attack to deal 6d4 additional damage. All additional damage is a turn by turn basis). This additional damage has a max of xd4 where x is equal to your proficiency bonus. If you are not a Cinq Association affiliate, you must move 20ft for every additional 1d4. Additionally, if you are affiliated with Cinq association, you gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

Name: Devyat Association Decay Knife
Need: Level 1 Devyat Association
Desc:
*Weapon (glaive)*

A large trunk containing many tools for the job, primarily used to deliver items across the city.
This knife deals 1d10 slashing damage and must be held in two hands. Upon hitting a target with this weapon, you will gain 1 `Courier Trunk::Courier Trunk`. You may store one items that is no bigger than 5X5 feet within the Courier Trunk. This item cannot be destroyed in any way and ill not contribute to weight.

Name: Devyat Association Decay Hammer
Need: Level 1 Devyat Association
Desc:
*Weapon (warhammer)*

A large trunk containing many tools for the job, primarily used to deliver items across the city.
This hammer deals 1d12 bludgeoning damage and must be held in two hands. Upon hitting a target with this weapon, you will gain 1 `Courier Trunk::Courier Trunk`. You may store one items that is no bigger than 5X5 feet within the Courier Trunk. This item cannot be destroyed in any way and ill not contribute to weight.

Name: Kurokumo Clan's Katana
Need: Level 1 Kurokumo Clan’s associate
Desc:
*Weapon (katana)*

A perfect blade, from tip to handle. You’ve never fashioned yourself on an over the top appearance, simply get results.
Cause an additional `bleed::Bleed` stack per hit and impose disadvantage on medicine checks to stop the bleeding. Recovering any amount of hit points will still stop the effect.

Name: R-Corp Rabbit Rifle and Knife
Need: Level 1 R-Corp associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Rifle and Knife)*

A compact Rifle made to suppress even the most devastating of abominations.
This rifle has a range of 60/180, holds a magazine size of 20 bullets, and deals 1d10 piercing damage per hit. If used by an `R-Corp::R-Corp` associate on the Rabbit team, damage increases to 2d6 and you do not attack with disadvantage while shooting within 5ft. The Knife deals 1d6 slashing. If used by a Rabbit team member, the knife deals 1d8 slashing and 1d4 lightning damage.

Name: R-Corp Reindeer Mace
Need: Level 1 R-Corp associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Mace)*

A mace that was specially made to increase the effects of their dampening field your suit provides.
This mace deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage, but grants the ability to attack at a range of 15ft. When attacking at a range, you deal 1d10 radiant damage. If used by an `R-Corp::R-Corp` associate on the Reindeer team, damage increases to 1d12 radiant damage and range increases to 30ft. Additionally, you may use your wisdom modifier for attack and damage rolls.

Name: R-Corp Rhino Hammer
Need: Level 1 R-Corp associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Maul)*

A hammer made only to be wielded by the strongest of warriors.
This hammer deals 1d12 bludgeoning damage, has the two handed and heavy property. If used by an `R-Corp::R-Corp` associate on the Rhino team, the weapon’s damage increases to 2d8, loses the heavy property in exchange for the reach property, and gains access to the slam feature. As an action you may cause all hostile creatures in a 15ft radius or cone to make a Dexterity save or be knocked back 10ft and knocked prone, taking 2x weapon damage on failure. On success creatures take half damage and suffer no additional effects. Any ground hit by this ability is treated as difficult terrain until fixed. You may use this slam an amount of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and it recharges on a long rest.

Name: N-Corp Oversized Nail
Need: Level 1 N-Corp affiliate with 16 Strength or 7th level fixer with 18 strength
Desc:
*Weapon (Lance)*

This Nail is far too heavy for a normal crusader, as such it was specially made for you.
This Nail deals 1d10 piercing damage and has the heavy and reach property. While being used by an `N-Corp::N-Corp` Affiliate, you gain the ability to taunt all creatures who can see or hear you. As an action, once per long rest, you may cause all creatures who can see or hear you to make a Charisma saving throw or be taunted to you until they make the save at the beginning of each of their turns. While taunted, affected creatures attack with disadvantage against other friendly creatures or allow advantage on saving throws they may impose.

Name: N-Corp's Vicious Nail
Need: Must be a 13th level N-Corp
Desc:
*Weapon (Javelin)*

A large nail about as large as a longsword.
This elongated nail deals 1d8 piercing damage and has the finesse property. Additionally, if you are an `N-Corp::N-Corp` associate, it gains the thrown property with a range 30/45ft and the returning property. When taking this Nail as a tool of the trade, This Nail is counted as a nail for the sake of your Drive the Nail feature. You may embed the nail in somebody as usual but retrieving it as a bonus action on a successful melee attack with a bludgeoning weapon dealing 1d8 piercing damage upon retrieval this way. Finally at 17th level as an N-Corp associate, you may make a special attack with this nail. After a successful ranged attack, you may choose to make the next attack you attempt to be a dash attack. Upon performing this attack, you may immediately move 45ft towards a target and make a melee attack with advantage. On hit you deal 2x weapon damage + 3x piercing damage. You may perform this special attack twice per long rest.

Name: Shi Association's Katana
Need: Must be a 7th level Shi Association associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Katana)*

This red blade is a symbol that many may fear, one that shows that a swift death is always around the corner.
This Katana deals 1d8 slashing damage and has the finesse and versatile property (1d10 slashing). If used by a `Shi Association::Shi Association` associate, every 30ft of movement you have at any given moment, you gain a +1 to attack rolls.

Name: The Middle's Chains
Need: Must be a Middle Affiliate
Desc:
*Weapon (Chains)*

These chains are wrapped around the body, mainly the arms, to slash at the opponent being pummeled.
Inflict 1 `Bleed::Bleed` on hit, gain 1 `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` on clashes against targets with Vengeance or Vendetta Mark. Creatures have disadvantage on breaking free of your grapples.

Name: Hana's Adaptive Weaponry
Need: Must be a Hana Association Affiliate
Desc:
*Weapon*

A black substance that morphes into any weapon you could think of, even covering body parts.
All attacks you make deal 1d10 damage between slashing, piercing, or bludgeoning depending on what shape the weapon is taking on. If you are a `Hana Association::Hana Association` affiliate, you may apply one weapon property to whatever is formed such as reach, light, or any other property so long as it is not the thrown property.

Name: Sweeper Sickles
Need: Must be a Sweeper Affiliate
Desc:
*Weapon (Sickle)*

These sickles are light and durable, making repeated strikes more effective.
This sickle deals 1d2 damage. If you are a sweeper, it becomes a +2 weapon.

Name: Gas Harpoon
Need: Must be a 7th level Pequod Affiliate
Desc:
*Weapon (Harpoon)*

A harpoon with a tip that generates heat the better in battle you do.
This harpoon deals 1d8/1d10 piercing damage with the versatile property and a throw range of 30ft with the returning property. After landing a full attack action or reducing a target to 0 hit points, the tip of the harpoon overheats and deals an additional 1d4 fire damage, inflicting `burn::Burn` stacks equal to the fire damage rolled. While overheated, you may throw it at a target as part of your attack action dealing an additional 8d6 fire damage on hit. After it is thrown while overheated, it must reheat itself to use that feature again.

Name: Vibroweld Morph Unauthorized Invention
Need: Must be a Yurodiviye associate
Desc:
*Weapon*

An unauthorized invention you've created in your spare time using your expertise in engineering.
This weapon may be any base dnd weapon so long as it has the finesse property. This weapon uses your intelligence instead of Strength or Dexterity. Choose one type of alternate tremor that you cannot already inflict. When triggering `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` or `Amplitude Entanglement::Amplitude Entanglement`, you may choose to inflict that `Tremor::Tremor` type instead or `Tremor - Reverberation::Tremor - Reverberation`. After selecting the alternate tremor, you cannot select a new one unless you tinker with your weapon for 1 hour or during a rest. Upon triggering `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst`, gain `Offense Level Up::Offense Level Up` until the end of your next turn.

Name: Chained Coffin
Need: Must be a 13th level Wild Hunt affiliate and a Strength of 18 or higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Coffin)*

A coffin that's been chained up. Is it to keep something in? Is it to keep something out? It doesn’t matter, just that you get ___ back.
This Coffin has the reach property of 15ft and deals 2d10 bludgeoning damage per hit. On hit with this weapon, the target must make a Strength save. On failure they either fall prone or are knocked 20ft away. When taking the attack action, only one of your attacks may use the Chained Coffin. Any damage that is dealt with this weapon is considered magical for the sake of overcoming resistances, treating immunity as if it were resistance. Finally, your 17th level feature changes from “Requiem” to “Lament, Mourn, and Despair”.

**Lament, Mourn, and Despair**

At 17th level, your pent up rage has reached its climax, just waiting to be unleashed like a raging tempest. Target one creature within 30ft and force them to make a Strength saving throw at disadvantage. On failure they take double your weapon damage + 5d12 Magical Piercing damage + 6d12 Lightning Damage as you swing the coffin forwards as it open to show spikes on the inside as it closes around the target before you pull them in and swing your weapon at the coffin before thunder cracks and strikes the coffin. On success save, target takes only the lightning damage. Additionally, gain 1 Coffin after using “Lament, Mourn, and Despair”. Lament, Mourn, and Despair

Name: Cursewrit Butcherblade
Need: Must be a 1st level Heishou Pack - Mao Branch associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Greatsword)*

This greatsword with a curse written on him is never a good sign. If you see it, it'll probably is going to be the last thing you see.
This greatsword is considered a Finesse weapon. If used by Heishou pack - Mao branch associate, you can make an opportunity attack against an enemy if they misses an attack against you. At 7-th level, you apply +2 `Rupture::Rupture` against targets who have less initiative or slower than you. Add another +2 if target has Deathrite.

Name: Heishou Pack - Si Branch Staff
Need: Must be a 1st level Heishou Pack - Si Branch associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Quarterstaff)*

This staff looks strange, with some purple hue and strange pattern at the end of it.
This quarterstaff is considered a Finesse weapon. If used by `Heishou Pack - Si Branch::Heishou Pack - Si Branch` associate, When inflicting Deathrite 【Venom】, inflict another stack of Deathrite. If you make an attack roll against target with Deathrite 【Venom】, Increase critical hit range by 1 . Upon inflicting `Rupture::Rupture`, inflict 2 extra rupture and additional 4 rupture on a critical hit.

Name: Dead Rabbits Bat
Need: Must be a 1st level Dead Rabbits Associate
Desc:
*Weapon (Bat)*

A baseball bat with nails crudely protruding from the end
This bat has the versatile property and deals 1d8/d10 bludgeoning damage. Every time you apply `Rupture::Rupture` with this weapon you also apply the same amount of `bleed::Bleed` on the target

Name: Oufi Association Halberd
Need: Must be an Oufi Association Affiliate
Desc:
*Weapon (Halberd)*

A baseball bat with nails crudely protruding from the end
You can use the polearm master feat even if you don't have it. If you already have the feat its damage becomes a 2d6. Whenever you would Trigger `Amplitude Conversion::Amplitude Conversion` into `Tremor - Decay::Tremor - Decay`, inflict `Tremor Burst::Tremor Burst` as well.

Name: Udjat Vanguard Shotgun
Need: Level 10 Udjat
Desc:
*Weapon (Shotgun)*

This weapon uses dexterity for it's rolls, has a range of 50/80 ft, and deals 2d8 piercing damage. If LCA Fracture Rounds are loaded into this weapon, increase the attack roll and damage roll by +2.

Name: Tiantui Star's Blade
Need: 17th level The Thumb, Melee Variant, Shin and Mang feat
Desc:
*Weapon (Longsword)*

A longsword with barrels and a revolver chamber which can hold specialized rounds.
This weapon has a +2 to attack and damage rolls. This weapon inflicts 2 `tremor::Tremor` on hit.

Once per long rest when you have no uses of Tigermark rounds and are concentrating on shin or mang you can gain a number of Savage Tigermark rounds equal to your max amount of Propellant Ammunition. When you make an attack you may choose to expend a Savage Tigermark round to deal an additional 2d8 fire damage, the target then gains count of burn equal to the damage dealt. As an action you also use Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬] which lets you attack a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. Creatures within 5ft of the target are also affected by these attacks if your attack rolls would hit normally. Inflicting 2 `burn::Burn` and 2 tremor-scorch per attack while the final attack inflicts `tremor burst::Tremor Burst` and you can choose to expend any amount of Savage Tigermark rounds on that attack. Any unexpended Savage Tigermark rounds are lost after this action.

Name: Bulletproof Vest
Need: Level 1 Fixer
Desc:
*Armor (Chain Mail)*

Standard issue bulletproof vest. It isn’t much but it’ll get the job done.
Your AC=14+Dexterity (up to +2) and you gain resistance to piercing damage.

Name: Liu Association's Coat
Need: Level 1 Liu Association associate
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

Its material is so complex and durable, yet it protects my body from harm.
While wearing this your AC=13+Dexterity. Additionally, gain resistance to slashing damage. Additionally, if you are a Liu Association associate, gain a +1 to AC. This benefit increases to +2 at 5th level, +3 at 15th level.

Name: Devyat Association Fixer Jacket
Need: Level 1 Devyat Association Fixer
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

Its material is so complex and durable, yet it protects my body from harm.
While wearing this your AC=14+CON (Max 16). Additionally, `Courier Trunk::Courier Trunk` Stack now gives buffs to the user. At 10+ Stack, Gain 10 feet of movement speed. At 20+ Stack, Gain +1 To attack rolls and damage rolls. At 30+ Stack, Inflict 1 `Rupture::Rupture` On Hit.

Name: Kurokumo Clan Robes
Need: level 1 level Kurokumo Clan associate
Desc:
*Armor (Robes)*

Black robes worn by those of the `Kurokumo Clan::Kurokumo Clan`.
While wearing, your AC=12+Dexterity. Gain a +1 to AC for every bleeding hostile creature, up to a maximum of +3. Gain a +2 AC if you are bleeding. Additionally, as a bonus action, you may apply one `bleed::Bleed` stack to yourself, ending it as a bonus action.

Name: Blade Lineage Durumagi
Need: Level 1 Blade Lineage Fixer
Desc:
*Armor (Robes)*

Black robes worn by those of the `Blade Lineage::Blade Lineage`.
While wearing these robes, your AC is equal to 12 + Dex Modifier. When a creature hits you, you gain 1 `poise::Poise` stack. `Clashing::Clashing` with a creature counts as it hitting you for this purpose. You may only gain a maximum of 5 Poise in a round with this property.

Name: K-Corp Excision Team Suit
Need: 13th level K-Corp affiliate
Desc:
*Armor (Plate)*

By being recruited to the Excision Team, you have been granted the opportunity to be modified to wear a special suit, one that passively grants you a constant flow of ampule fluid.
This armor grants the wearer an AC of 18. Additionally, the user recovers their Constitution modifier in hit points every turn so long as they are conscious. Finally, in the event you go down or die outright, the suit will automatically inject you with the revival ampule. This feature will activate once per long rest.

Name: N-Corp Crusader's Armor
Need: 7th level N-Corp associate
Desc:
*Armor (Half Plate or Plate)*

This Armor smells of blood and pungent metal, to be worn by those who annihilate all heretics.
While wearing your AC=15+Dexterity up to +2 or 18 depending on if you choose either the Half Plate or Plate versions respectively. If you are an `N-Corp::N-Corp` Associate, you may use your Drive the Nail feature as a bonus action.

Name: Dead Rabbits Clothing
Need: Must be a Dead Rabbits Associate
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

The condition of the clothes and the leather mask, don't give a friendly impression of you.
While wearing this armor, your AC=12+Dexterity. You have Disadvantage on any social check that is not intimidation which you roll with strength instead of charisma.

Name: Oufi Association Uniform
Need: Must be an Oufi Associate
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

Your Clothes are always to be in pristine condition as to further show the weight of a contract and your presence.
While wearing this armor, your AC=12+Dexterity. At the start of combat when using your Do Not Obstruct feature, you may Amplitude all `Tremor::Tremor` you apply this turn and all Tremor on the target to `Tremor - Decay::Tremor - Decay`

Name: TingTang Gang Shirt
Need: Level 7 TingTang Gang associate
Desc:
*Armor (Shirt)*

A Hawaii shirt made out of cloth.
While wearing this shirt, roll 1d10 at the start of your turn. Your AC equals the result of the roll + 5 and + your Dexterity modifier. As a bonus action, you can use your Take the Chance feature again, but on your AC.

Name: Pequod Harpooner Overcoat
Need: Must be a Pequod Crew member
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

A green button-down shirt made of thick fabric.
While wearing this armor, your AC is equal to 13 + your Charisma modifier. You gain resistance to piercing damage. Additionally, you have advantage on all attack rolls that target any sea creature.

Name: Index Uniform
Need: Must be an Index member
Desc:
*Armor (Coat)*

A uniform consisting of black formal attire, a short white cloak with a golden gorget and an `Index::The Index` badge.
While wearing this armor, your AC is equal to 12 + your dexterity modifier. When fulfilling a prescript, gain 1 `Poise::Poise`. When at 9 Grace of the Prescript, gain 1 Poise at the start of your turn.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Penitence
Need: Level 1 Fixer
Desc:
*Weapon (Warhammer)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d8 (1d10) Bludgeoning, Versatile. When landing a critical hit with this weapon via a Nat 20, recover 1d10 sanity. If not using a sanity mechanic, instead gain a +1d4 to attack rolls on your next turn.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Soda
Need: Level 1 Fixer
Desc:
*Weapon (Pistol)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d4 Piercing, Light, Range 30/90 feet, Reload (12 shots)This weapon does not require ammunition.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Wingbeat
Need: Level 1 Fixer
Desc:
*Weapon (Mace)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d8 Bludgeoning. Once per turn, when dealing damage with this weapon, you may recover HP equal to your proficiency bonus. This healing is doubled if the target has `Bleed::Bleed`.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Cavernous Wailing
Need: Level 1 Fixer
Desc:
*Weapon (Mace)*

Provided By Temp2005
Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d8 (1d10) Bludgeoning, Versatile. Inflict 1 `Sinking::Sinking` on a hit. When taking damage, gain 1 Blubberbubble Stack (Twice per Turn). When dealing dealing damage while having Blubberbubble Stacks, lose 1 Blubberbubble.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Tough
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Wielder must be Bald
Desc:
*Weapon (Pistol)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 3d4 Piercing, Light, Range 30/90 feet, Reload (12 shots). This weapon imposes a -1 to the next roll made by the target on a hit. If using a Sanity mechanic, instead deal 1d4 Sanity damage. This weapon does not require ammunition.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Fourth Match Flame
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Constitution 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Cannon)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 4d8 Fire, Two-Handed, Heavy, Range 50/150 feet, Loading. This weapon inflicts 4 `Burn::Burn` on hit. This weapon can only be fired once per round. This weapon does not require ammunition.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Solitude
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Revolver)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 4d4 Psychic, Heavy, Range 30/120 feet, Reload (6). This weapon does not require ammunition. This weapon inflicts 2 `Sinking::Sinking` on hit.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Red Eyes
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Constitution 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Warhammer)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d10 (1d12) Bludgeoning, Versatile. If the target has no `Bleed::Bleed`, this weapon inflicts 4 Bleed on hit. If the target has Bleed, deal an additional 2 damage on hit.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Horn
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Wisdom 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Warhammer)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d10 Bludgeoning. Deal an additional 1d6 damage to non-humanoid creatures.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Wrist Cutter
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Constitution 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Dagger)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d6 Psychic, Light, Finesse, Thrown (20/60). When landing an attack, you may roll a 1d4. Both you and the target gain `Bleed::Bleed` equal to the result. If you are wielding this weapon in one hand and nothing in the other, you may make an additional attack as a bonus action.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Regret
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Strength 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Maul)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d8 Bludgeoning, Two-Handed, Heavy. During an attack action, you may forgo all additional attacks to instead `burst tremor::Tremor Burst` on a hit. Otherwise, once per turn, inflict 1d4 `tremor::Tremor` on a hit.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Beak
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Dexterity 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Pistol)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d4 Piercing, Light, Range 30/90 feet, Reload (12). This weapon does not require ammunition. Gain a +1d4 to attack AND damage rolls against a creature that dealt damage to you since your last turn.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Fragments from Somewhere
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Intelligence 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Spear)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d8 (1d10) Necrotic, Versatile, Thrown (30/120). This weapon uses your Intelligence score for attack and damage roll calculation.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Lantern
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Strength 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Maul)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d12 Bludgeoning, Heavy, Two-Handed. When attacking while hidden, this weapon automatically rolls the maximum value on damage. This weapon inflicts 2 `rupture::Rupture` on a hit, and inflicts twice as much if attacking while hidden.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Today's Expression
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Pistol)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d4 Piercing, Light, Range 30/90 feet, Reload (12). This weapon does not require ammunition. When taking the attack action, roll a 1d10. Gain one of the following effects based on the result rolled until the end of the attack action.

* 1-2: -4 to hit, +4 to damage.
* 3-4: -2 to hit, +2 to damage.
* 5-6: Nothing happens.
* 7-8: +2 to hit, -2 to damage.
* 9-10: +4 to hit, -4 to damage.

Damage reduced by this effect cannot be reduced beyond 1.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Engulfing Dream
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Intelligence 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Pistol)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d4 Psychic, Light, Range 30/90 feet, Reload (12). This weapon deals double damage against an incapacitated, sleeping or stunned creature.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Cherry Blossoms
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Dexterity 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Dagger)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 2d4 Slashing, Light, Finesse. Hitting a Charmed creature with this weapon does not remove the Charmed status.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: SO CUTE!!!
Need: Level 5 Fixer, Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Cestus)*

Weapon Enchantment (+1): 1d8 Slashing, Light, Finesse, Glove.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Screaming Wedge
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Wisdom 15 or Higher and Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Crossbow)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 2d8 Psychic, Two-Handed, Loading, Range 80/320. This weapon does not require ammunition. This weapon inflicts 3 `Sinking::Sinking` on a hit. Once per turn, on a hit, impose a Wisdom saving throw on the target. On a failure, target creature is Frightened until the end of your next turn. Gain advantage on attack rolls against Frightened creatures.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Life for a Daredevil
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Strength or Dexterity 15 or Higher and Charisma 11 or Lower
Desc:
*Weapon (Katana)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 2d6 (2d8) Slashing, Versatile, Finesse. This weapon bypasses resistance to slashing, treats immunity to slashing as resistance, and cannot be reduced beyond half of the initial damage result. All damage this weapon deals is classified as Pale damage.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Bear Paws
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Strength 15 or Higher and Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Cestus)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 1d10 Slashing, Light, Finesse, Glove. Creatures grappled by you take damage equal to your weapon damage at the end of each of their turns.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Sanguine Desire
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Dexterity 15 or Higher and Strength 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Handaxe)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 3d4 Slashing, Light, Thrown 20/60 feet. This weapon inflicts 3 `Bleed::Bleed` on a hit. Gain a +1 to attack and damage rolls for every 10 bleed on the target (max 3).

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Syrinx
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Constitution 15 or Higher and Wisdom 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Crossbow)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 3d4 Thunder, Light, Range 30 feet. This weapon does not require ammunition. When taking the attack action, once per turn, you can instead target all creatures within a 15 foot cone.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Harmony
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Wisdom 15 or Higher and Charisma 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Sniper Rifle)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 4d10 Slashing + 4d10 Psychic, Two-Handed, Heavy, Range 50/150 feet. This weapon does not require ammunition, and can be fired once every other turn. If this weapon kills a creature, all other creatures within 5 feet of said creature must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed for 1 minute. A creature can remake the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of their turns to attempt to end the condition early.

Name: E.G.O. Weapon: Logging
Need: Level 9 Fixer, Strength 15 or Higher and Constitution 13 or Higher
Desc:
*Weapon (Greataxe)*

Weapon Enchantment (+2): 2d12 Slashing, Heavy, Two-Handed. Inflict 3 `Rupture::Rupture` on a hit with this weapon. After killing a creature, gain the following effects for the next three turns:

* Critical hit range is increased by 1.

A Nebulizer that steadies your breathing simply by holding it.
You and all allies gain an improved crit range by one until they land a critical, after which this gift no longer affects them.

Name: Shadow Bamboo Hat
Need: 7th level Fixer
Desc:
*Armor (Hat)*

A strange `Bamboo Hat::Bamboo Hat`. Upon wearing it, your body feels lighter, and your movement feels faster.
If user has more initiative than the enemy, add +1 to attack and damage rolls per 8 initiative above the enemy(max +3) and deduct 1 to enemy's attack and damage rolls made against you per 8 initiative difference(max -3). If used by `Heishou Pack - Mao Branch::Heishou Pack - Mao Branch` associate, gain +2 to initiative rolls.

Name: Clockwork Monocle
Need: 7th level Fixer
Desc:
*Wondrous item (Wondrous item)*

This monocle looks really expensive, but elegant. Best thing for a detective.\
You can use your Wisdom modifier for Investigation and History checks instead of Intelligence. You can reconstruct something that happened up to week ago. Upon activating, you can try to see what happened here in the past. The clockwork shows a lot of possible ways, so you need to pass a DC 15 Investigation check in order to understand which one is the most likely option.

Name: Darkflame Smoking Pipe
Desc:
*Wondrous item (Wondrous item)*

This smoking pipe burns a dark blue flame.
While using this E.G.O gift you gain 2 Attack Power Up and 1 `Fragile::Fragile` at the start of your turn. If currently user has a reduced Defense Level, gain 5 `Poise::Poise` before attack. as a bonus action you can generate one Magic Bullet.
